quickview.title: IB Math AA IA — Sports Analytics
quickview.cardText: Statistical analysis comparing performance patterns across categorized weeks using fantasy football data.
quickview.summary: Analyzed Kyler Murray’s weekly fantasy football performance and compared weeks around Call of Duty releases/events vs typical weeks to explore whether the pattern showed a measurable change in performance.
results: Built season-by-season comparisons for COD vs non-COD weeks
Computed averages and variability to evaluate consistency
Presented results in tables and visuals with a written conclusion.

quickview.title: IB Physics EE — Self-Driving Sensors
quickview.cardText: Technical research on wave-based sensing (LiDAR/radar) and object detection limits in autonomous vehicles.
quickview.summary: Researched how self-driving cars use wave-based sensors (LiDAR/radar/cameras) to detect objects and estimate distance, then discussed real-world limitations like weather interference and sensor uncertainty.
results: Explained time-of-flight distance measurement (conceptually) and compared sensor strengths/limitations
Discussed why multi-sensor fusion improves reliability
Produced a structured long-form technical paper.

quickview.title: Reverse Engineering of Toro Snowblower
